acceptance_criterion: 60 FPS viewport navigation with at least 1,000,000 preview points on the target workstation and a representative cloud

navigation_run.input: Repeated zoom-in/zoom-out wheel events on the viewer while sampling the live WebGL render loop

notes: The 3,000,000-point LOD is streamed from the live representative workshop cloud; it exceeds the 1,000,000-point acceptance minimum.
This verifies the tested local Edge/Radeon workstation and viewport size. It does not claim performance for other GPU/browser combinations.
